name: Teria Bahamut
source:
A supreme being in the form of a young girl who carries with her fragmented memories of a time long past. She claims to be unable to release more than 20% of her maximum potential, but can perform feats that are far and above the capabilities of man. She has a somewhat impish personality.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
